title: Load the ticket queue on the dashboard
description: This test verifies that an authenticated tenant user can open the dashboard and see the ticket list for their workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the dashboard
Verify the ticket list is displayed
Verify the workspace ticket queue is visible

title: Update a ticket status in the queue
description: This test verifies that a staff user can change a ticket status and see the updated status reflected immediately in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the dashboard
Open the ticket management area
Select an active ticket from the list
Update the ticket status
Verify the ticket status is updated in the list
Verify the updated status remains visible in the queue

title: Create a ticket for an existing customer
description: This test verifies that a staff user can create a ticket for an existing customer and see it appear in the queue.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the dashboard
Open the ticket management area
Start creating a new ticket for an existing customer
Select an existing customer
Submit the ticket form
Verify the new ticket appears in the list
Verify the ticket is stored in the queue view

title: Create a ticket for a new customer
description: This test verifies that a staff user can create a ticket for a new customer and see it appear in the queue.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the dashboard
Open the ticket management area
Start creating a new ticket for a new customer
Fill in the new customer details
Submit the ticket form
Verify the new ticket appears in the list
Verify the ticket is stored in the queue view

title: Put a ticket on hold and resume it
description: This test verifies that a staff user can move a ticket from active to on hold and back to active with the changes shown in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the dashboard
Open the ticket management area
Select an active ticket from the list
Put the ticket on hold
Resume the ticket service
Verify the ticket returns to the active flow
Verify the current ticket status is visible in the list

title: Cancel a ticket with a reason
description: This test verifies that a staff user can cancel a ticket with a reason and see it remain stored in the system.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the dashboard
Open the ticket management area
Select a ticket from the list
Cancel the ticket
Fill in a cancellation reason
Submit the cancellation
Verify the cancelled ticket remains stored
Verify the ticket is no longer shown as active

title: Reopen a cancelled ticket
description: This test verifies that a staff user can reopen a cancelled ticket and see it return to the waiting queue.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the dashboard
Open the ticket management area
Select a ticket that has been cancelled
Reopen the ticket
Verify the ticket returns to the waiting queue
Verify the ticket is still stored in the system

title: Block submitting a ticket with missing customer data
description: This test verifies that the ticket form prevents submission when required customer information is missing and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the dashboard
Open the ticket management area
Start creating a new ticket
Leave a required customer field empty
Submit the ticket form
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the ticket was not created

title: Prevent invalid ticket status transitions
description: This test verifies that the ticket list does not allow resuming a ticket that is not on hold or reopening a ticket that is not cancelled.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the dashboard
Open the ticket management area
Select an active ticket from the list
Attempt to resume the active ticket
Select a non-cancelled ticket from the list
Attempt to reopen the non-cancelled ticket
Verify invalid status actions are not applied
Verify the ticket statuses remain unchanged

title: Search tickets by keyword
description: Verify that ticket search returns correct results for a keyword.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the dashboard
Enter search keyword 'error' in ticket search box
Submit the search
Verify the list contains tickets matching the keyword
